question_text: Isabel has three sons and one daughter (María), all of whom are healthy. A brother and a maternal uncle of Isabel died because they were affected by Duchenne's disease; a recessive disease linked to the X chromosome. Currently, Maria wants to become pregnant and wants to know the risk of transmitting the disease to her offspring. With the data collected, what is the probability that Maria is a carrier of Duchenne's disease?
